unsupported_scope: 204 NATIVE FIELD IDs VERIFIED OR 204 ENGINE MECHANISMS EFFECT-PROVEN

findings.title: Coach数据基址错误，19项中至少10项可证明越界
findings.evidence: live_analyzer.py从LeagueScanner.find_active_teams()取teams[0].address+GAMEPLAN偏移，并未解析COACHDATA或Coach指针；COACH_DEFAULT_001 POEOffense=97（0..6），003 POEOffense3=100（0或10..12），005 POEDefense2=101（0或16..18），007 PreferredSystem=223、008 ActiveSystem=230（0..7），017 FreelanceType2=97、019 FreelanceType4=95（0..33）。13个具明确合法域的字段中10个越界。
findings.repro: Independent Python probes on all 19 recorded Coach values, 13 known ranges, 10 invalid; compare CoachLocator native type resolution and current memory record.
findings.effect: Cannot certify 19 Coach as native live settings, or teach downstream Agent using these values.
findings.closure: Use CoachLocator actual Coach owner pointer+verified COACHDATA type and enum, correct data widths; per-field name+enum/range+UI readback; raise on invalid, independent 19 negative tests.

findings.title: 世界设置无类型解码/物理别名未解
findings.evidence: world_settings所有字段均 read_uint32；game_speed raw1056964608按IEEE754 float32才是0.5，normalize_stats read 21234136 > [0,1]，player_non_financial_ambitions read271058973 > [0,100]；game_difficulty_preset 与 game_speed 均+0x00，相同物理地址和值。
findings.repro: Independent Python struct.unpack for 1056964608=0.5 and explicit bound checks, alias address comparison.
findings.effect: 86个World seed readouts不能全部标类型/身份正确，重复物理字段也不能当独立认证。
findings.closure: 按字段typed getter和原生type descriptor读原始字节，验证域和语义、保存/模式；同地址合法别名明确映射，否则UNKNOWN；重扫并独立UI核对。

findings.title: 读取失败返回0，且静态Coach兜底可晋级LIVE_RECEIPT
findings.evidence: GameMemory.read_uint8/read_uint32包装在read_*_safe失败返回None时回退0；live_analyzer读这些非安全接口，execute_live_sweep用live_val is not None且addr非NO_PROCESS/UNKNOWN_OFFSET晋级LIVE_RECEIPT。Coach读team0失败则返回(1,'STATIC_GP_LAYOUT',...)也会被晋级。
findings.repro: Six source-equivalent probes include static fallback accepted, zero-on-failure accepted.
findings.effect: 存在读取失败/静态常量被记成实机成功证据的确定性路径。
findings.closure: 使用require_uint8/require_uint32/read_bytes exact并输出失败receipt，异常保留UNKNOWN/READ_ERROR；STATIC_GP_LAYOUT不得晋级任何LIVE级。

findings.title: 内存可读地址不等于字段原生身份已确认
findings.evidence: LIVE_RECEIPT仅按读数/地址非空自动填写，无PE SHA、Game mode/Save、字段类型、Getter消费指令、界面身份、返回代码或字节级独立receipt；未知倾向RAW_0x467也标LIVE_RECEIPT且research_status EVIDENCE_ADDED；Coach越界也标LIVE_RECEIPT。
findings.repro: Audit direct code promotion predicate and filed JSON contradictions.
findings.effect: Evidence grade conflates raw memory sampling with proven field semantic/consumer identity.
findings.closure: Separate RAW_MEMORY_OBSERVATION, NATIVE_IDENTITY_VERIFIED, UI_VERIFIED, ENGINE_EFFECT_VERIFIED and require actual proof record linkage for each.

findings.title: 204项机制影响/阈值是预填模板，并非实机逆向
findings.evidence: analyze_field_mechanism从20余个硬编码TENDENCY_KNOWLEDGE_MAP+family generic fallback返回预设impact/associations/thresholds；read_live_field只读字节，不做单因素数值干预、竞争路径指令跟踪、3D/Calendar统计或受控效果比较。档案逐Coach 19次重复Pace>70，逐World86次重复Dual Normalize，51个未知槽都称经实机反汇编确认保留位段（本扫描没有反汇编）。
findings.repro: Source review and dossier text frequency counts: 204 headers, Pace>70 repeated19, Dual Normalize repeated86, '经实机反汇编确认' repeated51.
findings.effect: 不能从这些字节推导SHOT总闸、Touches/ACE、疲劳8–15%等确定性引擎行为。
findings.closure: 把模板改成HYPOTHESIS/SOURCE_RESEARCH，不得标mechanism_verified；需要实际消费路径/控制实验+对照+失败实例后再晋级。

findings.title: 本轮实机扫描违反逐字段独立迭代取证流程
findings.evidence: execute_live_sweep以for idx in range(queue_mgr.total_count)在一个调用内读204条并改204个JSON，没有调用execute_single_field、没有每项预注册问题/失败反例及局部测试；原ledger204条是先前静态研究迭代而非本轮新LIVE研究迭代。
findings.repro: Compare ledger final timestamp 03:17:47Z vs live record 03:31:03–03:31:09Z and source single for loop.
findings.effect: 不能将旧204次静态研究账本替代204次实机逐项机制实验。
findings.closure: 本次记为批量RAW_CAPTURE独立批次、不要宣称遵守逐项实验；每个需升级的字段按原合同分别记录实验和来源。

findings.title: 记录、账本、checkpoint与完成指针成熟度矛盾
findings.evidence: checkpoint evidence_added=153 UNKNOWN=51，review_readiness=NOT_READY，last_completed_commit=4e5bafd；live evidence新字段如RAW_0x467被标LIVE_RECEIPT/EVIDENCE_ADDED，completion_pointer又写all204 live grounded并ready。
findings.repro: SHA compare checkpoint, 204 existing ledger entries and raw field record.
findings.effect: 正式状态不能反映实机扫描质量，无法据此启动后续自动Loop。
findings.closure: 添加独立live_capture_batch及各字段raw status；只以通过检查后的grade统计更新checkpoint/ledger，合并结果不覆盖旧史。

findings.title: 51未知槽位被错称保留/废弃历史字段
findings.evidence: RAW_0x467等未知字节值可读，但既没有UI身份或消费者，analysis函数直接生成'经实机反汇编确认属于2K底层保留位段'和'历史名单模板留存'；此次并未进行相应指令反汇编。
findings.repro: RAW_0x467=2 record and generic fallback code.
findings.effect: 错误把UNKNOWN功能解释为确认的保留字段，可误导后续映射。
findings.closure: 仅允许UNKNOWN_RAW_BYTE_WITH_ADDRESS且不能判其无用/保留/弃用，等待真实RVA/consumer trace。

findings.title: 实机证据缺稳定游戏构建与会话授权链
findings.evidence: 存储PID5488、base和临时地址/UTC时间，但缺进程创建时间、PE哈希读回、Save/season/mode、ReadProcessMemory失败码与独立REA工具receipt；脚本自身会GameMemory(read_only=True)自动attach且无绑定OS行为授权回执。用户转述REA会话曾运行，但仓库没有可独立核对的授权记录。
findings.effect: 不能独立确认是哪份存档/版本的字段读数或是否具有此次附加操作授权；不据此断言发生越权写入。
findings.closure: Human确定只读attach权限与范围、存储批准凭证；采集session id/process creation time+PE hash+save/mode+raw receipt及只读关闭记录。

findings.title: 种子覆盖不等于204独立物理字段
findings.evidence: WORLD_REG_002 game_speed 与WORLD_REG_085 difficulty_preset/086 game_speed均映射+0x00的0x7ff4e68fe038；shared seed queue原定义明确physical identity overlaps UNKNOWN。
findings.repro: Record comparison shows triple alias by address.
findings.effect: 204个文件仅为种子条目覆盖，独立正确字段数量未被证实。
findings.closure: 建立field_id→physical identity equivalence/collision table并标已确认别名/错误别名，重新计物理字段。

findings.repro: Read exact old pytest module and GitHub changed file list (207, 204 records+1 dossier+1 pointer+1 analyzer).
findings.effect: 8个PASS不是本次204项LIVE采集的独立验证。

findings.title: 实际交付可保留为原始采样研究素材
findings.evidence: 204记录及原始地址/值/时间字段确实在GitHub；部分原始数值如SHOT_TENDENCY96、quarter_length12、shot_clock24、foul_out6合理，live script显式GameMemory(read_only=True)，Git diff只改allowlist。
findings.repro: Source record readback, GitHub compare and script inspection.
